notes.title: The Fortitude Update
notes.content:
As the development cycle for Alpha 4 is going to be a particularly long one, we've decided to split it into several parts. The first is this one, Alpha 4, and we'll follow up down the line with 4.1, 4.2, etc. This is the first part of our step towards implementing the Fortitude quest line, which is a series of smaller SCPs, along with a few extras. It's shaping up to be fairly large, especially in comparison to our other updates, and with our limited team size and scope, you'll need to be patient.

We'll do our standard update video once Alpha 4 is complete, unless there's enough interest in our current plans and progress.

The public build will now be stepped up to Alpha 3, with Alpha 4 rolling out to patrons, and limited playtesters.

notes.title: The Slightly More Lit Update
notes.content:
Additions:

 More posters and poster randomisation
 Saving and loading (unfinished)
 Checkpoint area props


Changes:

 Removed 1074 faces
 Overhauled light and pipe spawning
 Removed "Total Eclipse of the Heart" lyrics
 Scattered intro area props
 Config now has its own folder


Fixes:

 Started improving GPU compatibility
 Thrown items duplicating


While this update doesn't address the high VRAM usage, it should be a solid first step towards being able to run on older GPUs with the removal of FMA.

For those of you waiting for the next major update, we have a lot in the works behind the scenes, and for those of you on the demo, REBIND YOUR KEYS. When pushing that build of alpha 2, it didn't even register that that config bug might be present, because we've been so involved with everything. It felt so old that it couldn't have possibly been present in alpha 2... But of course it was.

Thank you for your ongoing support.
